nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance lookups and owner gating across UniswapExchange, ERC20 and Context
delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address in UniswapExchange.delegate: a.delegatecall(b) executes untrusted code in the token storage context
low-level external call address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn on an externally supplied token address, followed by abi.decode of returndata
raw uint arithmetic without SafeMath in UniswapExchange.transferFrom: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value

ERC20._transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint amount) internal, updates _balances using SafeMath

ERC20._burn(address account, uint amount) internal, decreases _balances and _totalSupply

ERC20.approve(address spender, uint amount) public, calls _approve with _msgSender

ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint subtractedValue) public, SafeMath.sub then _approve
Context._msgSender() internal view returns(address payable), returns msg.sender
Address.isContract(address account) internal view, extcodehash based contract existence check
SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b) internal pure, overflow-checked addition
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b) internal pure, underflow-checked subtraction
SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b) internal pure, overflow-checked multiplication (not used by the vulnerable contracts)
SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b) internal pure, division-by-zero checked division

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a transient argument of UniswapExchange.transfer/transferFrom and carries no independent semantics beyond the balance write
_value is the transient amount operand of the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic
_from is the transient debited account consumed by the ensure/balanceOf checks
a is the transient delegatecall target and has no meaning outside delegate
b is the transient calldata blob forwarded to delegatecall
_tos is the transient recipient array iterated inside the loop of batchSend
_value is the transient per-recipient amount multiplied into total inside batchSend
token is the transient call target of the low-level call in callOptionalReturn
data is the transient calldata payload of the low-level call in callOptionalReturn
saleNum is a transient configuration argument that is immediately stored into _saleNum
token is a transient configuration argument scaled into _minSale
maxToken is a transient configuration argument scaled into _maxSale
total is the intermediate product of the unchecked multiplication guarded only by a balance require
success/returndata are the direct outputs of the low-level token call and add no extra semantics
_spender is only the transient key written into allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
spender is only the transient key forwarded to _approve in ERC20.approve
amount is only the transient allowance value forwarded to _approve
recipient is a transient argument of the ERC20.transfer wrapper around _transfer
sender is a transient argument of the ERC20.transferFrom wrapper around _transfer
c is the intermediate sum of SafeMath.add and is fully described by that library function
